body:
**I agreed to: **

- reducing my fee for the months I am owed from GBP to USD, which is a reduction ~20%. 

- I agreed to pricing in a monthly average for this month. Even though it’s not something I knew about or really agree to necessarily. 

- I agreed to 9k a month moving forward, temporarily reducing my fee even further. I did these things to reduce stress of getting paid the monthly retainer I am owed. But it doesn’t seem to be enough. 

——— 

**What I haven’t agreed: **

- putting my payment owed for each month on each monthly trailing average. Because it’s taking what I am owed to about a 40% discount, which I don’t agree to. Moving forward I’m sure this is reasonable, because I know about it. But backdating when this is the first week I found out about this monthly average “rule”, is unfair and unnecessary for me, and I don’t see how it is fair for those reasons? 

**What i struggle with:**

- it never seems to be enough 

- integrity questioned

- people grandstanding at inappropriate times. I dont want a constant debate about funds i am owed. Though i do want to discuss improving this process, but using my invoice to prove your position on a wider discussion is not fair, and so i wont be participating in that wider discussion at this time. 

This process has led to people losing their sense of reason. There is a lot of pettiness and accusation, and it has got me to a point where I question my future participation in this, and it’s sucking my enthusasim for building Kabocha and growing what is starting to be a very interesting and thriving ecosystem. 

The council motion #104  will go to vote. And I hope people vote with a sense of reason and discretion.

Edg will go up in a bit, we are in low season right now, the thunder before the storm, lowering to 9k a month for the next coming two months, is a way of showing support to the edg, its going to catch up in a bit. This is wrong right?
Invoice for the past 2 months
it should be 3 right?

Can you please mention what exactly you delivered in the last two months instead of role names and descriptions?

We're collectively putting an end to the pre-funding of periodic contributors as it is not fair to other postpaid-only contributors.
Know more here:
[https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6392-monthly-incentives-standards](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6392-monthly-incentives-standards)
(Looking forward to your thoughts as well on the same.)

Another point against pre-funding would be as the Democracy on Kabocha is likely to go live in less than 3 months, it makes sense to fund the Kabocha-only contributors in KAB via Pallet_Mint in a postpaid manner. (Also, this will act as a good motivation for you to launch the democracy without any delay.)

Please remove my name under the jargon 'key founding startup and setup duties' as it is completely irrelevant there. I'm a solo contributor and in a DAO one should not take any reputation credit for working with someone. Nevertheless, I won't take credit for it but it's me who guided/helped you with multiple things and not the other way around **at all**. 

If you're a Kabocha-only contributor then Recoup should be 100% equivalent except for the NSP fee and not 50-50 as we previously agreed upon in the main Convertible Notes' Grants thread and the derived Kabocha Recoup thread.

I will of course remove your name from. And i am always grateful for your support, i hope you know that, and i am happy to tell you again. 

My work as Kabocha technical steward is a daily affair and dealing with stakeholders as a startup steward and product manager is a (more than) a full time job, with mandate, duty and responsibility on behalf of the community. 

I will continue with the structure of this proposal, but on my next proposal i can consider the structure you mentioned. 

The launch of Kabocha is outside the realm of my control so that is a risk for me. Money is not a key driver for me to deliver, the main driver for me is my duty and responsibility. 

This is a monthly retainer for my work as a key steward. 

The funding proposal will go on chain on Saturday because i have been holding off on this a while, and haven't been paid an invoice since May. 

All the best

> Another point against pre-funding would be as the Democracy on Kabocha is likely to go live in less than 3 months, it makes sense to fund the Kabocha-only contributors in KAB via Pallet_Mint in a postpaid manner. (Also, this will act as a good motivation for you to launch the democracy without any delay.)

A note on this [@Shankar Warang](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS) - KAB is likely to be relatively illiquid for a while and so KAB will not be the way we fund contributors, in fact we see KAB more like shares, than currency, so EDG will continue to be the way most projects get their initial funding.

Practically speaking, Kabocha, is going to be focused on Identity (Seeds) and Rights.

The work underway to unlock KSM, will alleviate the funding pressure on EDG.

EDG building stake in KAB, is how the two projects build together - but they are also different kinds of assets.
